Container.Name: nebulae-server
Container.Overview: Nebulae Server runs rtorrent plus the headless Nebulae engine bridge on your Unraid server. Install the original Nebulae desktop app on your workstation, then point it at this container (Settings - Server): the exact same native interface drives the torrents on the server. There is no web UI by design. Beta: the bridge serves plain HTTP on your LAN; keep it inside a trusted network.

Config.Name: API Token
Config.Description: Bearer token the Nebulae desktop app must present (pick a long random string)

Config.Name: Data directory
Config.Description: Downloads, session state and watch folder

Config.Name: Bridge port
Config.Description: Nebulae bridge API (desktop app connects here)
